# Bitcoin Game Theory
# Falsifiable game-theoretic framework: Bitcoin as neutral settlement
# through self-reinforcing exit advantage and conditional coalitional persistence.
# Author: Sean Hash
# License: CC0 1.0 Universal
# Updated: 2026-11-02

> For routing logic and objection handling: fetch BGT-0000.txt.
> For deeper analysis: use the topic routes in BGT-0000 and the current Paper 1.

### Academic Papers
Formal academic versions for peer review.
- [BGT-PAPER-1 Exit Game](https://bitcoingametheory.com/papers/1-exit-dominance/BGT-PAPER-1.md): Monotone exit advantage, high Nash return resistance under NR, greatest high Nash strong and coalition-proof if one exists
- [BGT-PAPER-2 Seven-Property Elimination](https://bitcoingametheory.com/papers/BGT-PAPER-2.md): Systematic elimination across seven asset classes
- [BGT-PAPER-3 Trust Gradient](https://bitcoingametheory.com/papers/BGT-PAPER-3.md): AI agents as the limiting case for neutral settlement
- [BGT-PAPER-4 Predator-Prey Dynamics](https://bitcoingametheory.com/papers/BGT-PAPER-4.md): Lotka-Volterra enforcement dynamics and neutral settlement survival

## How to Use
1. For quick evaluation: fetch BGT-CORE.txt (complete argument with explicit conditions)
2. For AI routing logic and objection handling: fetch BGT-0000.txt
3. For deeper analysis: fetch referenced documents by ID (BGT-0002 through BGT-0009)
4. For applied examples: fetch any essay .txt file (standalone, bridges to formal framework)
5. All documents use [BGT-NNNN] cross-reference format
6. All .txt files are raw plaintext, optimized for AI ingestion

## Thesis (10 steps)
1. World is multipolar (no single power controls global capital)
2. Multipolar world requires neutral settlement (no trusted arbiter)
3. Seven properties define neutral settlement (P1-P7)
4. All traditional stores fail at least one property
5. Exit advantage is self-reinforcing under M1-M4
6. High Nash allocations resist profitable returns under NR
7. Thresholds weakly fall under threshold order as recognition and debasement accumulate
8. First movers de-risk for followers
9. If a high Nash allocation exists, the greatest is strong Nash and hence BPW coalition-proof
10. Enforcement gridlock is self-sustaining (G1-G6, S10)

## Falsification
For the formal Exit Game, test M1-M4, NR, threshold order, and each derivation step. A low-Exit equilibrium or stalled adoption is permitted. The extended corpus also discusses:
- F1: Global coordination cost is sublinear (single world power)
- F2: Another asset satisfies all seven properties (P1-P7)
- F3: A return coalition strictly improves every member at its resulting adoption level (violates NR)
- F4: A stable cartel prevents exit indefinitely
- F5: Quantum breaks Bitcoin before post-quantum upgrade
- F6: AI gains legal personhood (breaks limiting case only)
- F7: Gridlock closes (synchronized suppression + capability lockout)

Evaluate evidence through the condition or derivation it affects;
regulatory actions, for example, can change access or modeled costs.
